outcome: transfusion of packed red blood cells (PRBC)
cohort: 53 cases of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) with pathological confirmation between 2010 and 2021 from a tertiary care institution in Portugal
finding: The creation of an MDT was associated with a reduction in mean EBL and the median number of PRBC units transfused, despite a higher number of invasive PAS disorders.
